newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bosch sells radio unit to Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Bosch sells radio unit to Motorola.

text.p: German automotive parts supplier Robert Bosch GmbH said on Wednesday it has sold its mobile radio business to U.S.-based Motorola Inc.
Bosch said the divestment of the unit, which has annual sales of about 330 million marks and employs almost 1,500 workers, was part of its strategic plan to concentrate on core businesses.
Terms of the deal for the unit, which produces technology for radio transmission between vehicles, were not disclosed. The deal must also be approved by the German cartel office.

Bosch said Motorola would use the acquisition to strengthen its position in Europe. The deal includes Bosch's operation in Berlin, Swiss-based Radiocom AG, as well as other locations in Germany and abroad.
